english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a quantity becoming larger or making a quantity larger.
This is the all-purpose choice for increasing an amount, degree, or number.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when boosting an amount, number, or chance of success.
Use this when the enhancement chiefly means increasing the amount, extent, or number of features.
Use this for an amount, level, skill, or strength becoming greater rather than for gaining possession.
Use this for the general sense of increasing an amount, level, or effect.
Use 增加 when a quantity or intensity increases, such as bills, pressure, or tension.
Use 增加 specifically when an amount or quantity grows, rather than when it physically moves upward or a price rises.
